items.title: HOCKEY: HOPE AND REALITY
items.description:
Pakistan’s hockey team won the bronze medal at the 2026 Asian Games. Is this satisfactory or unsatisfactory? The answer to this is not straightforward.

items.title: Pope Leo has cancerous tumour removed in lung operation
items.description:
Pope Leo XIV had a cancerous tumour removed from his right lung in a 90-minute operation on Tuesday and “woke up normally” after the procedure, the Vatican said.
A Vatican source said further tests were being carried out to determine if the cancer had spread.
“To ensure the procedure was radical, the lower lobe of the right lung was removed,” the Vatican said in a statement.
The operation “confirmed the diagnosis of a pulmonary adenocarcinoma, as suspected from the pre-operative tests”, it said.

items.title: Karachi swelters as mercury soars to 38.7°C
items.description:
KARACHI: The city experienced hot weather on Tuesday as the temperature rose to 38.7 degrees Celsius with humidity recorded at 43 per cent, making conditions uncomfortable for people.  

A Met official said October is usually a warm month in Karachi and is often referred to as the city’s “second summer”. He added that the recent rise in temperatures is linked to a high-pressure area in the upper atmosphere, which has weakened winds and caused temperatures to rise.  

The official warned that the mercury could touch 40°C if the current trend continues.

items.description:
